Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.

Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 0343/2019, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC,
registered at PS: Gandhi Nagar, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom.

Learned APP for the State and learned counsel for respondent No. 2 (through VC)
appear on advance notice and accept notice.
Status report / reply be filed with an advance copy to learned counsel for the petitioners.
Trial Court Record be summoned in digital format since the chargesheet is stated to have been filed.
Petitioners as well as respondent No. 2 are directed to remain present in person on the next date of hearing.
